openingStatement: Some ideas need to be dismantled before they can be understood.
description: abstractly concrete. the art of unthinking. An interactive exhibition of paintings and writing by giles c mccrary iii.

abstractRoom.title: abstract your own concrete.
abstractRoom.hint: A word, an object, a certainty — anything you hold as fixed.

field.label: abstractly concrete / participation
field.title: the field.
field.invitation:
An artwork without a final form.
It begins with an idea. What remains is yours to discover. What you leave becomes part of something larger.
field.contributorNote: Every piece in the field was made by a visitor. Pieces are contributions to the work, not works by giles c mccrary iii, and are not individually endorsed by the artist.
creditLines: a participatory artwork by giles c mccrary iii
